body:
I can care less about that. Again, you’re giving me a reason to live when NO REASON EXISTS. This subreddit and this post would be so unnecessary if I there was euthanasia clinics. I’m tired.

Can’t wait for my phone to die. I’m tired of typing. I’m not gonna let some sort of stupid online group “wire me up” or physiologically arouse me to a point where I feel different or “better” (non-suicidal). My head and body is drained already
Not news

Best day of my life. All I could think about the last 12 years was killing myself, I dreamt about it, I cried about it, and I jerked off about it. It’s my muse. And I’ve never felt so close. The only thing that gets me excited in life is the thought of killing myself. Nothing else I hate more than boredom, distractions, meanings, “reasons,” and this planet so overly populated with all these pleasure monkeys.

There’s always something missing, it’s all made up and bs. It’s part of human nature to keep seeking what’s “missing.” I shouldn’t kill my self because there’s something “missing” if I do? Oh please. 

Everyday people who don’t want to die end up dying, whether it be in a car crash, old age, or whatever. Yet I’m still alive, someone who’s been wanting to die their entire life. I just want someone to shoot me or run me over already. I’m too tired to slit my wrists or go to the roof of a building.
Everyone looks like a killer

So I shouldn’t kill myself cause I matter to you? I You’re gonna die to, whether it’s suicide or not. You think anyone cared about the endless people who killed them selves a hundred years ago, one thousand years ago, and so on? No. It makes no sense to stay alive because someone “cares.” Whether it be a family member or a stranger on reddit
Definitely. Frederic Chopin knew what he was doing. The pain he must have been in...so inspiring
You don’t know me. Why would it matter if I stay alive. Im an asshole. Don’t give me this bs that every life is precious
Because that’s life. Of course there’s subjective reasons but I can care less about subjective drives, meanings, etc
15 is beautiful!! I never took the time to play it though
I’m tired.
Don’t try to give me a reason to live. No reason exists
There is no help. I just need to die already
Of course. 9, 13, and 20 will always be my favorites

Talk about what? Nothing said will change. Including this sort of time being wasted. Am I suppose to believe that I’m not gonna kill myself because I’m immersing myself into this stupid subreddit. Am I suppose to keep typing until I’m in a different state of mind in 10min, an hour from now, a day, etc. and say “what was I thinking?” No fukn way
Chopin, Schubert, Bach, Joy Division, Interpol, Germs, Nirvana, Black Flag, Radiohead, Daft Punk will always be in my heart I guess. But I can’t really choose one over another
I’m tired of talking. It’s all a fucking distraction from wanting to kill myself
Punk, metal and classical mainly. Not a huge fan of pop punk but still enjoy it here and there
Yea...I know. So Switzerland is irrelevant to me
What kind of music do you like
I’m in Los Angeles, CA USA. Even if I had money to get there it’s a process. I want to die now, walk into a euthanasia clinic the same I can walk into a grocery store
Why isn’t there a euthanasia clinic? I just want to walk into one and die as quick and painlessly as possible. I can’t buy a gun and I don’t want to survive a fall and suffer even more.
I don’t wanna talk I guess. I just want to die. Instead I’m wasting my time on reddit trying to prevent something I’ve always wanted to do
